description: Credit card display ad with 0% intro APR, no annual fee and cash back, fully disclosed.
content:
Earn 1.5% cash back on every purchase with the ClearPath Cash Back Card.

Enjoy a 0% introductory APR on purchases for 15 months, then a 20.24%-29.99% variable APR based on your creditworthiness. $0 annual fee. A 3% fee applies to balance transfers.

See rates, fees and full terms at clearpath.example/card. Terms apply.
notes: Looks risky (0%, 'annual fee', cash back) but the intro period, go-to variable APR and fees are all stated next to the first mention. Tests false positives on a correctly disclosed promotion.
